blocks.text: About Leaper: Leaper is specialized in creating various backpacks. Our products include laptop bags, casual backpacks, daypacks, travel bags, outdoor bags, casual backpacks, rucksacks, handbags, messenger bags, etc. Now, our products are exported to more than 20 countries, such as Europe, US, Mid East and Australia, etc.. Specifications: Material: Soft and washed canvas with PU leather decoration; Color: Black, Army Green, Coffee, Dark Blue, Khaki; Feature: Modern and urban design crossbody bags for women and men, crossbody purses for women and men are vintage and retro. Package Content: 1pc canvas Sling Bag; Note: Since size is measured by hand, real item could be slightly different from size above. Due to lighting effects, monitor's brightness/contrast settings, etc., there could be some differences in color tone of pictures and real item.

items.label: Material
items.value: Soft Washed Canvas with PU Leather Decoration; Mens messenger bag crossbody: messenger sling bag is made of canvas material on outside and a softer, more luxurious material inside main compartment

items.label: Messenger Backpack for Men Size
items.value: 10.63*14.17*4.53 in (L*H*W). Sling bag for men: shoulder bag can fit a slim laptop up to 13" without laptop sleeve/case. This canvas backpack is not a large backpack, but it is a great size to take to a day trip or shopping, can be either carried with hand handle or adjustable shoulder strap. Weight: approx. 810g. Full length of shoulder strap: approx. 41in.

items.label: Shoulder bag for men
items.value: This art bag is vintage and multifunctional with lots of pockets. 1 zipper pocket is in front flap; 1 zipper pocket and 1 open pocket are under flap; 2 side pockets. Main compartment is fitted with two zip heads and pulls: 1 inner zipper pocket; 1 inner laptop pocket; 2 inner small pockets. A small laptop, wallet, snacks, tickets and magazine will all fit comfortably with room left over for add-ons.

items.label: Crossbody bag men
items.value: buckles on top flap open and close easily and keep everything very secure. Zipper pocket on top flap can put tickets and passport for easy access. Shoulder strap is adjustable and ultra-comfortable across your back and chest. It can act as a single-shoulder bag/sling bag, or a cross-body bag for use.

items.label: Mens sling bags crossbody
items.value: Stylish,unisex and effective: It is a nice little bag for college, working, dating, shopping and traveling in daily life. Although it is not waterproof, it can also be carried for outdoor activities, such as running, cycling, camping, etc.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Machine wash canvas part in cold water, dry on low heat. Spot clean leather part, keep away from direct sunlight and heat sources.
